case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS.2643-2644 OF 2023 (Arising out of S.L.P.(Crl.) Nos. 6854-6855 of 2023)
summary: Unrepresented appellant in murder appeal; appointed counsel inadequately prepared; argued non-existent common intention under s.34 IPC; failure to grant reasonable preparation time; due process violation; partial allowance: impugned judgment set aside and remanded to High Court for fresh hearing; bail granted due to prolonged incarceration.
final_judgment: Appeal partly allowed; impugned judgment dated 12.05.2022 set aside for Niranjan Das; remanded to High Court; bail granted with production before Trial Court within one week.
